title: Require Domain Operation Rule Import Boundaries
forbids: operation rules importing outside shared MapGen primitives, type-only local algorithm vocabulary, sibling rules, and exact ancestor model atoms and policy; direct-module rules may additionally consume named sibling-module atoms
why: Rules are private algorithm mechanics inside one operation. A positive dependency boundary keeps contracts and artifacts as composition owners while preserving transparent access to the semantic vocabulary actually owned by the rule's module and domain.
remediate: Pass admitted values from the strategy, move reusable semantic schema and types to the nearest model/atoms owner, move reusable decisions to model/policy, and keep private algorithm composition inside the operation rules directory.
message: Operation rules must stay within their positive algorithm and model dependency boundary.
